dataset: Johnbrick123/sp500-data release data + Kenneth French daily US market research factors
limitations: USA only; dated S&P500 membership instead of global market-cap universe; all contemporaneous members rather than Top100
No historical sectors: Hybrid sector factor is neutral zero; all variants use identical US-only proxy risk and price/trend/momentum screens
Market-only OLS residual with independent Fama-French broad-US total return
USD nominal account, zero cash yield; no historical EUR
Adjusted total-return units, no separate dividend withholding, historical engine tax schedule extrapolated before 2012
Execution at observed next session close (weekly baseline, daily adaptive swap); no carried-patch trading

Research-only observed exits after membership removal and 60-day stale off-index settlement at last known quote; cash recovery assumed, not verified; marks carried up to 60 sessions; 35-day lot lock preserved
Passive ETF proxy is Fama-French cap-weighted US market, synthetic 0.07% TER, 10bps each side, 1 currency-unit each side and same stamp/tax schedule; no fund-level withholding

Original risk sizing and tax simulator reused, not exact global Atlas replay; V6.7 one discretionary pair per month, 0.5% hurdle buffer, no tuning; FIFO holding restriction, weighted-average fiscal cost basis as in the proxy simulator
